verses.text: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix yak' owal cha makan heb' winh rey. Jun makan heb' winh: Haton winhaj Amrafel sreyal Sinar, winhaj Arioc sreyal Elasar, winhaj Quedorlaomer sreyal Elam yet' winhaj Tidal sreyal Goim. Junxo makan heb': Haton winhaj Bera sreyal Sodoma, winhaj Birsa sreyal Gomorra, winhaj Sinab sreyal Adma, winhaj Semeber sreyal Zeboim yet' winh sreyal Bela, haton jun chonhab' Zoar tiknaik.
Ha owanh heb' winh rey chi' ix slajtiej sb'a heb' winh, junxonhej ix yutej soldado heb' winh t'a jun ak'lik skuch Sidim b'aj ay ha' mar Muerto tiknaik.
Ha heb' winh rey chi', slajchawilxo ab'il yajoch heb' winh t'a yalanh smandar winhaj rey Quedorlaomer. Axo ix ek' junxo ab'il majxo yak'laj k'een tumin heb' winh syak'taxon t'a winh.

Yuj chi' t'a junxo ab'il ix b'at winh rey chi' yet' oxwanhxo heb' winh rey ayoch yet'ok t'a yol yik Astarot Karnaim. Ata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' refaíta yuj heb' winh. Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' zuzita yuj heb' winh t'a yol yik Ham. Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' winh emita yuj heb' winh t'a yol yik Sawe-kiriataim.
Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' horeo yuj heb' winh t'a jun tzalan skuch Seir, ix pechji heb' masanto t'a jun ak'lik Parán, t'a slak'anil jun lum takinh lu'um.

Ayik ix meltzajxi winhaj rey Quedorlaomer yet' heb' winh ayoch yet'ok, ix jawi heb' winh t'a En-mispat, anheja' jun lugar chi' skuchanpax Cades. Ix satel masanil tas ay t'a yol yik heb' amalekita yuj heb' winh yet' tas ay t'a heb' amorreo ay t'a yol yik Hazezon-tamar.

Axo owanh heb' winh rey, haton winh yik Sodoma, winh yik Gomorra, winh yik Adma, winh yik Zeboim yet' winh yik Bela, ix b'at heb' winh t'a ak'lik Sidim. Ata' ix yak' owal heb' winh yet' chanhwanhxo heb' winh rey chi', haton winhaj Quedorlaomer, winhaj Tidal, winhaj Amrafel yet' winhaj Arioc.

Ha t'a yak'likal Sidim chi', tzijtum b'ajtak sk'eta jun asfalto te tzayayi. Yuj chi' ayik ix b'at winh sreyal Sodoma yet' winh yik Gomorra elelal, ay heb' soldado heb' ix b'atkan t'a skal asfalto chi', ay juntzanhxo heb' ix b'atkan elelal t'a jolomtak witz.
Ha chanhwanh heb' winh rey ix ak'an ganar chi', ix b'at heb' winh yik'elta masanil tas swaji yet' masanil tas te ay stojol t'a Sodoma yet' t'a Gomorra chi', ix b'at heb' winh b'ian.
Ha winhaj Lot, sk'ab' yok winhaj Abram, kajan t'a Sodoma chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yuj heb' winh yet' masanil tas ay t'ay.

Palta ay jun winh ixto yak' ganar yeli, ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Abram winh hebreo to ix ik'jib'at winhaj Lot chi'. Ha winhaj Abram chi' kajan winh t'a slak'anil juntzanh te' ji t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Mamre winh amorreo, yuk'tak sb'a yet' winhaj Escol yet' winhaj Aner. Ha heb' chi' wach' yak'an heb' yet' winhaj Abram chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Abram to ix ik'jib'at winhaj Lot chi', ix smolb'an masanil heb' schekab' winh k'ayb'ab'il t'a owal, haton heb' ix alji t'a yol skuenta winh, 318 heb' smasanil. Ix b'at heb' t'a spatik heb' chanhwanh rey chi' masanto b'aj ay chonhab' Dan tiknaik, ata' ix yamchaj heb' yuj heb'.

Axo t'ak'walil ix spojanb'at masanil heb' swinak winhaj Abram chi', ix och heb' winh yak' owal yet' chanhwanh heb' winh rey chi'. Ix pechji heb' winh yuj heb' winh, masanto t'a Hoba t'a yichanhb'at chonhab' Damasco ix k'och heb' winh.
Ix yik'anxiek' winhaj Abram jantak tastak ix yik'ek' heb' chi', ix ek'xikan winhaj Lot yet' masanil tas ay t'ay yet' pax heb' ix ix yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix ik'jib'at yuj heb' winh rey chi'.

Ayik toxo ix ak'ji ganar winhaj rey Quedorlaomer yet' heb' winh rey ayoch yet'ok yuj winhaj Abram chi', ix meltzajxi winh yet' heb' ix kolchajkan chi' yuj. Axo winh sreyal Sodoma ix elta t'a yol b'e scha winh t'a jun ch'olan skuch Sawe, Ch'olan yik heb' Rey sb'i paxi.
Ha winhaj Melquisedec, sreyal Salem, sakerdoteal Dios Axonhej Niwan Yelk'ochi, a winh ix ak'an ixim pan yet' wino t'a winhaj Abram chi'.
Ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winh icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh, haton Dios Axonhej Niwan Yelk'ochi, haton ixb'o'an satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um.

Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Dios ix ak'anoch heb' ajk'ol t'a yol a k'ab', xchi winh t'a winhaj Abram chi'. Ixlajwi chi', a jantak tastak ix yik'ek' winhaj Abram t'a heb' winh rey chi', ix yak'an sdiezmoal winh t'a winhaj Melquisedec chi'.
Axo ix yalan winh sreyal Sodoma t'a winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: --Anhej heb' anima tzak' meltzaj t'ayin, haxo masanil tastak, kanokab' t'ayach, xchi winh.
Axo ix yalan winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix wak' in ti' t'a Jehová, haton Dios Axonhej Niwan Yelk'ochi, jun ixb'o'an satcha'anh yet' yol yib'anhk'inal tik,
to malaj jab'ok tas skan t'ayin, malaj wal jab'ok ch'al ma junok ch'anhal xanhab' skan t'ayin, yik wach' manh ol ala' to uuj tzin och b'eyumal.

Malaj jab'ok tas ix b'at wik'ek' tik tzin nib'ej skan t'ayin, anhej tas ix swa heb' in chekab'. Axo heb' ajun wet' tik, haton winhaj Aner, winhaj Escol yet' winhaj Mamre, a heb' winh tik, schaokab' yik heb' winh.
